name: Suspicious Curl.EXE Download
description: Detects a suspicious curl process start on Windows and outputs the requested document to a local file
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*\\curl.exe OR process.pe.product:The\ curl\ executable) AND ((process.command_line:(*%AppData%* OR *%Public%* OR *%Temp%* OR *%tmp%* OR *\\AppData\\* OR *\\Desktop\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *C\:\\PerfLogs\\* OR *C\:\\ProgramData\\* OR *C\:\\Windows\\Temp\\*)) OR (process.command_line:(*.dll OR *.gif OR *.jpeg OR *.jpg OR *.png OR *.temp OR *.tmp OR *.txt OR *.vbe OR *.vbs))) AND (NOT (process.parent.executable:C\:\\Program\ Files\\Git\\usr\\bin\\sh.exe AND process.executable:C\:\\Program\ Files\\Git\\mingw64\\bin\\curl.exe AND (process.command_line:*\-\-silent\ \-\-show\-error\ \-\-output\ * AND process.command_line:*gfw\-httpget\-* AND process.command_line:*AppData*)))
